metadata.title: DRAFT — NIST SP 800-53B MODERATE + MITRE SAFE-AI Overlay — MODERATE Impact AI-Enabled System Baseline

props.name: source-publication
props.value: MITRE SAFE-AI: A Framework for Securing AI-Enabled Systems (MP250397, April 2025), Appendix D Table 2 'AI Controls'

parties.name: Charter (derived from NIST SP 800-53B and the cited AI source)

metadata.remarks: DRAFT. Derived from NIST SP 800-53 Revision 5.2.0 MODERATE Impact Baseline plus all 100 AI-affected controls listed in MITRE SAFE-AI Appendix D Table 2, attached regardless of baseline so the system owner or security engineer can mark non-applicable controls per system. Four PM controls from the table are included; PM is organization-level. No control is removed. MITRE's AI-specific guidance text is not copied; each alter cites the report. SAFE-AI is a MITRE work product, not a NIST publication.
